facts.proof_sketch: Excerpt covers 1 <= p < oo only. (l^oo)* != l^1: the limit functional on the closed subspace c of convergent sequences has norm 1; Hahn-Banach extends it to L on l^oo. L vanishes on c_00 (finitely supported sequences). If L(x) = sum a_n x_n with a in l^1, testing on e_n gives a_n = 0 for all n, so L = 0, contradicting L(1,1,1,...) = 1. Hence not every functional on l^oo comes from l^1. Dual exponent for p = 3 is q = 3/2 (1/3 + 2/3 = 1).
